title: An authored page:header action list silently hides every action whose locations include record_header but which the list does not name — an app author (or an AI) gets no signal at os lint, os validate or build
body:
Filing gate ①, class (c): a metadata-authoring trap, measured. Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` execution seat (seat post objectstack-ai/hotcrm#1353, `session_01WnMDsLSaUQUD41WaWnADcF`) from the dev report on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2072 (PR objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2084). ⛔ Not graded here: triage grades and routes. ⛔ Not a claim.

## The trap

An app declares an action with `locations: ['record_header', …]` and authors a record page whose `page:header` names an explicit `actions` id list. The action then never reaches that header unless the list names it. The placement the action declares is silently not honoured, and nothing says so:
- `os lint --strict` (`@objectstack/lint` 17.7.0): the `page:header` branch of `action-name-undefined` (dist ~L10232) checks only the dangling direction, an id that names no action (#20105).
- `os validate` and the build: nothing either.
- The renderer draws only the listed ids: objectui `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx`, `headerActionPlan` / `resolvedHeaderActions`.

## Reach (a named real producer)

HotCRM's `case_detail_page` listed `['escalate_case', 'close_case', 'log_call']` while `claim_case`, `log_meeting` and `schedule_meeting` declared `record_header` for `crm_case`. Measured in the hosted browser pass (objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2072, CASE-00034): an agent on an unowned queue case could not claim it from its own page. HotCRM fixed its list (PR objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2084) and keeps a test of its own pages. The trap stays open for every other app, and for every AI that authors a header list.

## For triage

Which remedy, if any, is the platform's call. The two shapes in view:
- a declared placement that an authored list can override says so at authoring time;
- or a `record_header` placement is honoured whatever the list names.

The reporting seat proposes no new gate.

## Duplicate check

`search_issues` (semantic, objectstack-ai/objectstack, all states):
- "page:header actions list omits action declared record_header location silently hidden lint warning" → 0 hits.
- Control "action-name-undefined lint rule page header action ids" → 11 hits, none on point. #20105 (closed) added the dangling-id direction for `page:header`, the opposite case.

objectstack-ai/objectui: "record_header action not rendered custom record page header actions whitelist" → 6 hits, none on point.
